test_title: PYST 228: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 13th Dec,, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.

I could not went for my sister’s wedding in Rajasthan as I had my final examination at that time.
solution:
The correct answer is **'could not went'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in Simple Past tense. 
 
• As the auxiliary **'could'** is already in its V2 (can-could) form so the main verb should have been&
